description.narrative: The Project is expected to result in improved quality in the toll-road, by increasing capacity with lane expansions, reducing accidents, and incorporating technology solutions with traffic monitoring systems and digital toll collection. In addition, tariffs will decrease and new discounts will be offered to the users. Beyond the Project, this transaction is expected to enhance the competitive structure of the market and increase the share of private participation in the sector, especially by demonstrating the viability of the ongoing concession agreements in the sector.

The proposed investment is a bridge facility of up to BRL 700 million for Concessionaire de Rodovias Noroeste Paulista S.A. (the Company). The Company was established to operate, improve, and maintain 600 km of brownfield toll-road segments in the State of Sao Paulo in Brazil, under a 30-year concession awarded in 2022.
